content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `afs_deliver_fs_rename()` and `yfs_deliver_fs_rename()` functions only decoding the second file status when the parent directories were different. This oversight meant that when the source and destination directories were the same, the XDR pointer was not advanced correctly, leading to incorrect reading of the volume synchronization record. The fix involved ensuring that the second status was always decoded, allowing the directory data version numbers to be updated correctly regardless of whether the directories were the same or different.
